summary: Rejected. The candidate exactly replays and passes compact and geometry validation, and its removals of 47 dated later-reference attestations plus 42 inherited active-date hints are generally source-faithful. However, it retains claim-20 and the sole active hint AD 953 for Mingzong. The only source evidence is the AD 953 Later Zhou ritual memorial: it retrospectively says that when Mingzong performed a suburban sacrifice, bamboo tablets were used. It does not place Mingzong's sacrifice in AD 953. This remaining false personal-activity date prevents acceptance.

reviewedOperations.review: The 47 claim replacements preserve the cited historical-precedent, quotation, temple, posthumous-title, or later ritual attestations as explicitly undated. The 42 paired hint changes remove only derived activity labels. I independently sampled every source group: ancestral temple debates (s0002–s0018), quoted authorities and historical precedents (s0039–s0058 and s0098), current temple/posthumous actions (s0100, s0123, s0133, s0145, s0156), comparative precedents (s0139, s0152, s0161–s0166), and later temple installations (s0172–s0184). These removals do not discard a source-dated personal event.
